result.brief: 提出世界动作评论家模型，联合学习候选动作条件下的未来预测与后果评估，用评论家信号塑造预测表征，并在自动驾驶规划中验证。
result.reason: Joint candidate-conditioned future prediction and critic learning shapes predictive representations for action evaluation; applied to autonomous driving policy, so world-model application rather than core representation.
